messages:
Rina: Quick thought experiment: what if we regroup the left rail by task flow (Ingest -> Train -> Serve -> Observe) instead of product surface? Mock attached. Goal: fewer cognitive hops when people are working on a single feature. Keen on feedback, esp. permalinks + keyboard behavior.

Theo: Love the mental model. Two immediate flags: 1) existing deep links used in docs and integrations expect `/console/models/:id/...` paths, 2) keyboard users rely on consistent tree ordering for muscle memory. Any change should maintain stable URLs and provide a keyboard shortcut to jump to the active cluster.

Rina: Agree. Proposal: keep canonical resource paths (e.g. `/console/models/:id`) but introduce a routing layer that maps the UI cluster state -> query param `?cluster=serve` and a short fragment for section anchors `#panel=latency`. That way bookmarks still resolve.

Carlos: Slightly worried about analytics and server logs that bucket by path. If we rely on query params, we should normalize them server-side for reporting (strip session-specific params) or emit a synthetic path in analytics like `/console/models/:id/cluster/serve`.

Anya: Accessibility notes: when switching clusters via the left rail, screen reader should announce "Switched to Serve cluster" and focus should move to the first focusable element in the cluster. Also provide `aria-current="true"` on the active rail item. We should avoid using only color to indicate active.

NavBot: /check keyboard-shortcuts -> Found: `g c` currently jumps to 'Clusters' but no per-cluster quick jump exists. Suggest adding `g s` -> jump to Serve, `g i` -> Ingest, etc., and expose them in the help modal.

Rina: Good call. Keyboard quick-jump + persisted cluster in localStorage could help power users. But persistence must not override explicit deep links. Order of precedence: 1) URL path/params 2) fragment anchor 3) explicit user action 4) stored preference.

Theo: On breadcrumbs: current pattern is "Console > Models > 123". Suggest we expand to "Console 7 Models 7 ImageGen-v1.2" for more context and to avoid ambiguity in teams with many similarly named models. For overflow, truncate with `…` and reveal via tooltip. On mobile collapse to a single crumb plus a contextual title.

Carlos: For anchor handling, let's implement a tiny shim:

```
// on load
const hash = new URL(location).hash;
if (hash.startsWith('#panel=')) {
  const panel = hash.split('=')[1];
  router.replace({ pathname: location.pathname, query: { ...router.query, panel } }, undefined, { shallow: true });
  focusPanel(panel);
}
```

Use `replace` to avoid polluting history. Tests should validate back-button works.

Anya: Also ensure that when we programmatically focus a panel we call `announceForAccessibility('Panel: ' + panelLabel)` so AT users get context. Add `role="region"` and `aria-labelledby` for each panel container.

Rina: Action items (owners): 1) Routing shim + migration plan (Theo) — include redirects and analytics mapping; 2) Keyboard shortcuts + help modal updates (Carlos); 3) ARIA announcements, `aria-current`, focus management (Anya). I'll draft a short migration doc and sequence for the rollout.

Theo: I'll prototype the routing adaptor and include integration tests that assert legacy links still resolve. Will include example redirects in netlify/_redirects and a node lambda for server-side fallback. ETA Wed.

Carlos: I'll add `g <letter>` bindings and a small user pref toggle to enable/disable quick-jump. Will add unit tests for focus order and an E2E test using puppeteer to simulate keyboard nav.

Anya: I'll add the aria attributes, ARIA live announcement helpers, and run `axe-core` across the new nav permutations. Will post results here.

Rina: UX copy: breadcrumbs guideline: max 48 chars, use middle truncation for model names, tooltip copy to be exact model slug. Also recommend showing version in breadcrumb if present. I'll share mock updates.

Theo: One more: deep links coming from external docs may include utm params. We should preserve non-routing query params across redirects (`utm_source`, `ref`). Add test cases for that.

NavBot: Reminder: Sync scheduled Thu 11:00 — calendar invite sent.

Rina: Thanks all — small, iterative rollout sounds right. Will open RFC PR with the mock, migration notes, and a short checklist for the release coach. :rocket:
